commitments.detail: Review and provide necessary documentation for the student's participation eligibility.
Attend eight hours of academic integrity workshops as part of the corrective plan.
Schedule an in-person family conference for next Monday after school to discuss the incident and corrective actions.
Review and submit a corrective plan by next Friday.
The student's participation in the regional competition will be denied until the integrity issue is resolved.
The student must attend eight hours of academic integrity workshops.
A mandatory family conference will be held next Monday at 3:00 PM to discuss the incident and the corrective actions.
Review and provide a plan for addressing the integrity issue.
